# Histoire Parfumerie

> > A curated exploration of perfume history, from iconic fragrances like Chanel N°5 and Diorissimo to contemporary creations, tracing the heritage of French haute couture parfumerie and niche perfume houses.

Founded by Henri Dufresne, Histoire Parfumerie chronicles the stories behind legendary fragrances and the master perfumers who created them. The site focuses on French perfumery traditions, examining both historic masterpieces from houses like Chanel, Dior, and Guerlain, and modern innovations from Serge Lutens, Frédéric Malle, and contemporary designers.

## Key Topics

- Chanel N°5 and aldehyde revolution
- Christian Dior and haute couture parfumerie
- Serge Lutens and Palais Royal
- Guerlain heritage
- French perfumery tradition
- Niche perfumery movement
- Master perfumers (Ernest Beaux, Edmond Roudnitska, Jacques Polge)
- Floral compositions and white florals
- Gourmand fragrances
- Oriental and woody accords
- 1920s-1950s perfume innovation
- Contemporary fragrance launches (2025-2026)
- Japanese-Western fusion in perfumery
- Haute couture fashion houses
- Perfume historical archives

## About & Mission

- [À propos](https://histoire-parfumerie.com/a-propos): Henri Dufresne's journey researching perfume houses & historical archives
- [Histoire Parfumerie](https://histoire-parfumerie.com): Homepage: Journey through olfactory heritage & luxury fragrance history
- [Accueil](https://histoire-parfumerie.com/accueil): Homepage: Journey through olfactory heritage featuring luxury houses

## Iconic Classics (1920s-1950s)

- [Chanel N°5 : Quand Coco a bouleversé la parfumerie](https://histoire-parfumerie.com/histoire-chanel-n-5-chanel-2): Chanel N°5: Coco Chanel & Ernest Beaux' 1920s aldehyde revolution
- [Miss Dior : Histoire d'une révolution parfumée](https://histoire-parfumerie.com/histoire-miss-dior-dior): Miss Dior (1947): Christian Dior's tribute to Catherine via Paul Vacher
- [Diorissimo : le muguet impossible de Christian Dior](https://histoire-parfumerie.com/histoire-diorissimo-dior): Diorissimo (1956): Edmond Roudnitska's synthetic lily-of-the-valley triumph

## Modern Masterpieces (1996-2005)

- [Allure de Chanel : L'élégance réinventée en 1996](https://histoire-parfumerie.com/histoire-allure-chanel): Chanel Allure (1996): Jacques Polge's fresh oriental with vanilla-vetiver
- [Rose de Nuit : la rose épicée qui bouleversa la parfumerie](https://histoire-parfumerie.com/histoire-rose-de-nuit-lutens): Serge Lutens' Rose de Nuit (2001): cumin-spiked rose by Sheldrake
- [Vetiver Extraordinaire : La Révolution Malle de 2002](https://histoire-parfumerie.com/histoire-vetiver-extraordinaire-malle): Frédéric Malle & Dominique Ropion's Vetiver Extraordinaire (2002) manifesto
- [Flowerbomb : L'Explosion Florale qui Révolutionna la Parfumerie](https://histoire-parfumerie.com/histoire-flowerbomb-viktor-rolf-2): Viktor & Rolf's Flowerbomb (2005): floral-gourmand revolution by Dutch duo

## Contemporary Haute Couture (2017-2025)

- [Gucci Bloom : la renaissance florale d'une maison romaine](https://histoire-parfumerie.com/histoire-gucci-bloom-gucci): Gucci Bloom (2017): Alessandro Michele & Alberto Morillas' white floral
- [Le Rouge Flower by Kenzo (2025) : L'audace japonaise](https://histoire-parfumerie.com/histoire-le-rouge-flower-by-kenzo-1): Kenzo's Le Rouge Flower (2025): Japanese-Western fusion with musk opening

## 2026 New Releases

- [La Nuit Tombée de Lutens : L'Ombre Parfumée de 2026](https://histoire-parfumerie.com/histoire-la-nuit-tomb-e-lutens-2): Serge Lutens' La Nuit Tombée (2026): minimalist incense-patchouli-cedar
- [Scandal Pour Homme Elixir : La Révolution Olfactive Gaultier](https://histoire-parfumerie.com/histoire-scandal-pour-homme-elixir-gaultier): Jean Paul Gaultier's Scandal Pour Homme Elixir (2026): bold oriental woody
- [Valentino Uomo Born in Roma Purple Melancholia (2026)](https://histoire-parfumerie.com/histoire-valentino-uomo-born-in-roma-purple-melancholia-valentino): Valentino Purple Melancholia (2026): explosive cardamom-led masculine
- [Boss Bottled Striking Lavender : La Renaissance de 2026](https://histoire-parfumerie.com/histoire-boss-bottled-striking-lavender-boss): Hugo Boss Bottled Striking Lavender (2026): mineral contemporary lavender
- [Mademoiselle Rochas In Love : quand la passion s'invite](https://histoire-parfumerie.com/histoire-mademoiselle-rochas-in-love-love): Mademoiselle Rochas In Love (2026): salted tuberose oriental floral
- [Yes I Am Gold de Cacharel : L'Audace Dorée de 2026](https://histoire-parfumerie.com/histoire-yes-i-am-gold-cacharel): Cacharel's Yes I Am Gold (2026): golden evolution of 2018 fragrance saga
- [Nina EDP (2026) : Ricci Réinvente son Icône Gourmande](https://histoire-parfumerie.com/histoire-nina-edp-ricci): Nina Ricci's Nina EDP (2026): lavender-licorice-cypress sophistication
